title: Distill Until Divergence: Error-Truncated Hindsight Distillation for Agentic RL
abstract: arXiv:2610.23048v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon interaction requires agents to make multiple decisions in a changing environment. Outcome-based GRPO lacks fine-grained guidance for intermediate decisions. Recent methods distill completed trajectories into reusable skills and use hindsight-conditioned OPD to provide dense token-level credit. However, skill-induced probability shifts do not necessarily represent reward-aligned credit; especially after an erroneous action changes subsequent interaction states, skill-conditioned supervision may become mismatched with the current state. To address this mismatch, we propose \methodname{}, which routes two complementary hindsight skills according to trajectory outcomes and error boundaries: Positive skills capture successful workflows to reinforce successful trajectories and pre-error decisions, while Negative skills capture failure-specific corrections to target decisive errors. translated_title: 蒸馏直至分歧：面向智能体强化学习的误差截断事后蒸馏
translated_abstract: 长程交互要求智能体在不断变化的环境中做出多个决策。基于结果的GRPO缺乏对中间决策的细粒度指导。近期的些方法将完整轨迹蒸馏为可复用的技能，并使用事后条件化的OPD来提供密集的token级信用分配。然而，技能引起的概率偏移并不一定代表与奖励对齐的信用；尤其是在错误动作改变了后续交互状态之后，技能条件化的监督可能与当前状态不匹配。为了解决这种不匹配问题，我们提出了该方法，它根据轨迹结果和误差边界来路由两种互补的事后技能：正向技能捕捉成功的工作流程，以强化成功轨迹和错误发生前的决策；负向技能捕捉失败特有的纠正信息，以针对决定性错误。错误发生后的后缀部分仅通过（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种面向智能体强化学习的误差截断事后蒸馏方法，通过根据轨迹结果和误差边界路由正向技能（强化成功流程与错误前决策）和负向技能（针对决定性错误进行纠正）两种互补的事后技能，解决了技能条件化监督与错误后状态不匹配的问题，实现与奖励对齐的细粒度信用分配。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Error-Truncated Hindsight Distillation for agentic RL, which routes complementary positive skills (reinforcing successful workflows and pre-error decisions) and negative skills (targeting decisive errors) based on trajectory outcomes and error boundaries, resolving the mismatch between skill-conditioned supervision and post-error states to achieve reward-aligned fine-grained credit assignment.
